title: Entgelttransparenzgesetz in force
description: Information right >200 employees; reporting >500.
implication_hypothesis: Baseline that the new directive tightens.

title: New quality system for nursing homes replaces Pflegenoten
description: Inpatient Pflegenoten replaced by indicator-based quality presentation and new MD inspections.
implication_hypothesis: Loss of simple grades raises need for easy-to-read quality orientation.

title: WEG reform (WEMoG) in force
description: Reform of the Wohnungseigentumsgesetz takes effect, introducing the certified administrator concept.
implication_hypothesis: Owners gain rights to demand professional, certified administration.

title: Law on distribution of broker commissions (§§656c, 656d BGB)
description: Buyers of flats/single-family homes pay at most half of the broker commission; text form required.
implication_hypothesis: Sellers bear more cost and choose agents more deliberately.

title: BGH I ZR 134/20 (Obi) on test-seal advertising
description: Seal advertising must give a clearly accessible reference (Fundstelle).
implication_hypothesis: Seal design must include source reference.

title: KfW 440 wallbox subsidy stopped
description: Programme closed after funds exhausted; 689,980 of 974,449 applications funded.
implication_hypothesis: No current home-charging subsidy; installers compete without public quality signal.

title: ZertVerwV (certified administrator exam regulation) in force
description: Defines IHK exam for zertifizierter Verwalter.
implication_hypothesis: Creates a verifiable qualification attribute for lists.

title: New Gebührenordnung für Tierärzte (GOT) in force
description: Replaces 1999 fee schedule; raised vet fees.
implication_hypothesis: Higher vet bills increase pet owners' need for orientation on vets and pet insurance.

title: LG München I enjoins FOCUS doctor seals
description: Seals in test-mark design deemed misleading; licence 1,900 EUR net/yr.
implication_hypothesis: Seal business models are legally exposed.

title: Entitlement to a certified WEG administrator
description: WEG owners can demand a certified administrator (postponed from 2022).
implication_hypothesis: Owners look for certified managers; orientation demand.

title: End of Umweltbonus EV purchase premium
description: No new applications after 17 Dec 2023 after the budget ruling; ~2.2m vehicles funded since 2016.
implication_hypothesis: Created BEV slump in 2024 and a later used-EV wave needing trusted dealers/battery checks.

title: GEG amendment (Heizungsgesetz) in force
description: 65% renewable requirement for new heating in new development areas; existing buildings linked to heat planning.
implication_hypothesis: Uncertainty drove 2024 heat pump slump.

title: KfW takes over BEG heating funding from BAFA
description: KfW processes BEG heating grants from 2024.
implication_hypothesis: New process; installer guidance needed.

title: Qualifizierungsgeld (Weiterbildungsgesetz) starts
description: §§ 82a-82c SGB III wage replacement for training during structural change.
implication_hypothesis: Funded training demand needs provider orientation.

title: Solarpaket I adopted
description: Plug-in solar limit raised to 800 W, simplified registration; applies from May 2024.
implication_hypothesis: Boost in balcony PV purchases and seller market.

title: Bundes-Klinik-Atlas launched
description: Federal hospital transparency portal launched by BMG.
implication_hypothesis: Official transparency push competes with media rankings.

title: Transitional certification for long-standing administrators ends
description: Administrators in office on 1 Dec 2020 no longer deemed certified.
implication_hypothesis: Shake-out of uncertified managers.

title: BGH I ZR 98/23 (Katjes) on 'klimaneutral' advertising
description: Advertising 'klimaneutral' must explain in the ad whether reduction or offsetting.
implication_hypothesis: Strict standards for green claims/seals.

title: BAFA energy advice grant cut from 80% to 50%
description: Grant caps halved (EUR 650 / 850) due to demand and budget.
implication_hypothesis: Price sensitivity raises need to compare energy advisers.

title: Krankenhausversorgungsverbesserungsgesetz (KHVVG) in force
description: Introduces Leistungsgruppen with quality criteria and Vorhaltevergütung.
implication_hypothesis: Hospitals reorganise service lines; patients need to know who still offers what.

title: Pflegekasse home adaptation grant raised to EUR 4,180
description: §40 SGB XI per-measure grant up from EUR 4,000.
implication_hypothesis: Stable funding source for stairlifts/bathrooms.

title: KfW 455-B without budget in 2025
description: No grant applications possible in 2025.
implication_hypothesis: Stop-and-go funding confuses consumers.

title: New Grundsteuer applies
description: Reformed property tax based on new assessed values applies from 2025.
implication_hypothesis: Owners seek appraisers/tax advice; objections.

title: E-invoice receipt obligation (B2B)
description: All businesses must be able to receive e-invoices.
implication_hypothesis: SMEs need tax advisers/software support.

title: New Grundsteuer applies
description: Almost 36 million properties revalued; many objections.
implication_hypothesis: Owners seek tax advice/objection support.

title: Insurers start creating ePA (opt-out)
description: ePA created for all statutory insured unless objected.
implication_hypothesis: Digital readiness of practices becomes a selection criterion.

title: AI Act Art. 4 AI literacy obligation applies
description: All firms using AI must take AI-literacy measures.
implication_hypothesis: Demand for AI-training providers ranking.

title: Solarspitzengesetz in force
description: No EEG payment during negative prices for new PV >=2 kWp; 60% feed-in cap without control box.
implication_hypothesis: Shift to storage/energy management increases advice complexity.

title: ePA nationwide rollout for providers
description: ePA für alle available nationwide.

title: OLG München reverses: FOCUS seals not misleading
description: Treated seals as current test-result advertising.
implication_hypothesis: Temporary relief for seal model.

title: Commission announces intention to withdraw Green Claims Directive (June 2025)
description: Trilogue paused; status uncertain; Nov 2026 report says independent verification dropped.
implication_hypothesis: Absent ex-ante verification, credible third-party assessments gain value. Month-level date precision.

title: Barrierefreiheitsstärkungsgesetz applies
description: Accessibility for e-commerce services and products; micro service firms exempt.
implication_hypothesis: SMEs seek web-accessibility agencies - orientation gap.

title: Klinik-Atlas project group dissolved
description: BMG project group dissolved retroactively; department took over 1 July 2025; later operated under G-BA.
implication_hypothesis: Weakened official tool: space for independent hospital orientation.

title: VMK decides Deutschlandticket EUR 63
description: Special transport ministers' conference sets EUR 63 from 2026.
implication_hypothesis: Rising price pushes comparisons of mobility alternatives (car sharing).

title: Mandatory ePA use for practices and hospitals
description: Providers obliged to use ePA.
implication_hypothesis: Practice digitalisation can be benchmarked.

title: Bundestag adopts Pflegefachassistenzgesetz
description: Uniform federal care-assistant training; Bundesrat approval 17 Oct 2025.
implication_hypothesis: New qualification profile may reshape staffing and employer branding in care.

title: Bundestag adopts Schuldnerberatungsdienstegesetz (SchuBerDG)
description: Implements Art. 36 CCD: states must ensure access to independent debt counselling.
implication_hypothesis: Expansion of counselling capacity; quality transparency of counselling services could matter.

title: Transposition deadline Consumer Credit Directive (EU) 2023/2225
description: Member states had to transpose CCD II by 20 Nov 2025; Germany missed it.
implication_hypothesis: Delay plus new rules creates uncertainty for credit/BNPL providers and intermediaries.

title: EU Driving Licence Directive (EU) 2025/2205 in force
description: Accompanied driving at 17 EU-wide, digital licence by 2030, 2-year probation.
implication_hypothesis: Further changes to training models.

title: Bundestag passes Rentenpaket 2025
description: Extends 48% Haltelinie to 2031, introduces Aktivrente, Mütterrente equalisation from 2027; Bundesrat 19 Dec 2025.
implication_hypothesis: Pension debate raises demand for retirement planning advice.

title: NIS2UmsuCG in force
description: New BSIG; ~29,000 entities in scope.
implication_hypothesis: Demand for vetted cybersecurity service providers.

title: BFH confirms Grundsteuer Bundesmodell
description: BFH II R 25/24, II R 31/24, II R 3/25 rule model constitutional.
implication_hypothesis: Individual valuation proofs (appraisers) become main route for objections.

title: Bund-Länder working group 'Zukunftspakt Pflege' final report
description: Options on financing (indexation, Sockel-Spitze-Tausch); few concrete decisions.
implication_hypothesis: Prolonged uncertainty for families on costs.

title: BEEP (Befugniserweiterung und Entbürokratisierung in der Pflege) mostly in force
description: Successor of planned Pflegekompetenzgesetz; extends nurses' competencies; further parts 1 July 2026 and 1 Jan 2027.
implication_hypothesis: Nurse-led services become more visible and differentiable.

title: EUR 4 bn special fund for Kita expansion 2026-2029
description: Sondervermögen funds for Kita expansion/renovation; KiQuTG ~EUR 2 bn/yr.
implication_hypothesis: Quality differences among Kitas become visible as places grow.

title: New EV purchase subsidy (retroactive start)
description: Subsidy EUR 1,500-6,000 for registrations from 1 Jan 2026, income cap EUR 80,000.
implication_hypothesis: New, lower-income first-time EV buyers need orientation on dealers/workshops.

title: Deutschlandticket price rises to EUR 63
description: Monthly price EUR 63.
implication_hypothesis: Price sensitivity; subscriber churn as in Jan 2025.

title: Aktivrente in force
description: Employees past statutory retirement age may earn up to 2,000 EUR/month tax-free.
implication_hypothesis: Creates tax/payroll advice needs for older workers and employers ('senior-friendly employers').

title: Key points for Gebäudemodernisierungsgesetz
description: Abolish 65% rule, Bio-Treppe from 2029, BEG to continue to 2029.
implication_hypothesis: Renewed uncertainty for heating decisions.

title: NIS2 registration deadline at BSI
description: Three months after entry into force.
implication_hypothesis: Compliance consulting market peak.

title: Bundestag passes Altersvorsorgereformgesetz (Altersvorsorgedepot)
description: New subsidised pension depot replaces Riester for new contracts.
implication_hypothesis: Huge product switch: consumers need orientation on providers of Altersvorsorgedepots.

title: Transposition deadline EmpCo Directive (EU) 2024/825
description: Member states must transpose rules against greenwashing and on sustainability labels.
implication_hypothesis: Germany implements via UWG (BT-Drs. 21/1855).

title: Bundesrat approves Krankenhausreformanpassungsgesetz (KHAG)
description: Leistungsgruppen reduced to 61, more Länder flexibility.
implication_hypothesis: Specialty-level lists aligned to Leistungsgruppen become relevant.

title: KfW 455-B relaunched with EUR 50m
description: Grant reopened.
implication_hypothesis: Short window drives rush demand for adaptation firms.

title: Psychotherapy fee cut debate (Bewertungsausschuss)
description: BPtK reports practices losing about 3% of fees under 2026 reassessment.
implication_hypothesis: Capacity pressure may worsen waits; demand for guidance to self-pay/online offers.

title: Bundestag adopts CCD implementation law
description: Brings BNPL and small loans under consumer credit law; new § 34k GewO licence for credit intermediaries.
implication_hypothesis: New licensed intermediary category = new population to assess.

title: Government calls mediation committee on SchuBerDG
description: Federal government invoked the Vermittlungsausschuss before final promulgation in Oct 2026.
implication_hypothesis: Shows political dispute over who finances debt counselling capacity (Länder).

title: BAFA application portal for EV subsidy opens
description: Online portal launched; EUR 3 bn for ~800,000 vehicles.
implication_hypothesis: Demand spike for EV dealers, wallbox installers.

title: Cabinet adopts driving-licence reform (Fahrlehrergesetz amendment)
description: Digital theory, no minimum special drives, simpler theory exam.
implication_hypothesis: Driving-school market will differentiate on price/quality - orientation gap.

title: Referentenentwurf Pflegeneuordnungsgesetz presented
description: Draft with delayed nursing-home surcharges, indexation, Pflegebegleitung, dropping 131 EUR relief for Pflegegrad 1.
implication_hypothesis: Rising out-of-pocket burden increases price/value comparison need.

title: Transposition deadline EU Pay Transparency Directive missed
description: Germany missed deadline; law expected early 2027.
implication_hypothesis: Employers will need pay-equity audits/advice; 'fair pay' employer seals become relevant.

title: Municipal heat planning deadline for cities >100,000
description: Under GEG 2024 regime cities must publish heat plans.
implication_hypothesis: Triggers heating decisions in large cities.

title: New quality system introduced in ambulatory care; Pflegenoten ended
description: Ambulatory care services move to the new quality system; Pflegenoten finally abolished.
implication_hypothesis: Ambulatory services (15,549) lack a familiar grade; window for TOP Pflegedienste list.

title: Bundestag and Bundesrat pass Gebäudemodernisierungsgesetz (GModG)
description: 65% renewable rule removed; fossil heating allowed with rising green fuel quotas from 2029.
implication_hypothesis: Choice between technologies widens; consumers need neutral advice.

title: BEG reform: new funding conditions
description: Base 30%, speed bonus 16%, income bonus up to 40%, lower cost caps; degression from Feb 2027.
implication_hypothesis: Time pressure for owners before degression.

title: Continuing-education duty for estate agents abolished
description: §34c Weiterbildungspflicht dropped for Makler, kept for Wohnimmobilienverwalter.
implication_hypothesis: Fewer statutory quality signals for agents; private seals gain relevance.

title: GModG in force (replaces GEG)
description: Promulgated 28 July 2026, first provisions from 29 July 2026.
implication_hypothesis: New rule set needs explaining by installers/advisers.

title: KfW 455-B funds exhausted
description: Applications stopped after less than four months; no 2027 funds in draft.
implication_hypothesis: Owners rely on Pflegekasse grant and loans.

title: BGH I ZR 130/25: strict standards for paid FOCUS seals, remand to OLG
description: Paid seal provision is commercial act under UWG; criticised self-reported data, repeat listings; logos may mislead if limits not disclosed.
implication_hypothesis: Direct methodological requirement for all FACTS lists incl. Top Anwälte/Steuerberater; new topics must have defensible, transparent methodology.

title: Right to Repair rules apply
description: Implementation of Directive (EU) 2024/1799 into BGB/EGBGB for sales contracts from 31 Jul 2026; online repair platform required.
implication_hypothesis: Consumers need orientation on repair providers (repair shops ranking).

title: Legal entitlement to full-day care for grade 1
description: Ganztag entitlement starts, extended to grades 1-4 by 2029/30.
implication_hypothesis: Parents compare OGS/Ganztag providers; ~264k places still missing.

title: EmpCo rules apply (UWG): ban of generic green claims and uncertified sustainability labels
description: Sustainability labels must be based on certification schemes or public authorities; generic environmental claims banned.
implication_hypothesis: Any 'green provider' seal must have a certification scheme - opportunity and legal risk for FACTS.

title: Cabinet adopts Pflegeneuordnungsgesetz (PNOG)
description: Childless surcharge to 0.9%, spouse surcharge 0.52 points from 2028, ceiling +300 EUR; parliamentary process pending.
implication_hypothesis: Reform debate keeps care costs in public focus in 2026/27.

title: SchuBerDG promulgated (BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 293)
description: Promulgated after mediation-committee step in May 2026.
implication_hypothesis: Final legal basis for counselling access.

title: Bundestag passes Frühstart-Rente
description: 10 EUR/month per child aged 6-18 into capital-funded account.
implication_hypothesis: Parents need orientation on depot providers.

title: BMJV/BMF key points on natural-hazard (Elementar) cover
description: Elementar cover to be standard in new residential building policies (opt-out); comments until 2 Dec 2026; bill expected 2027.
implication_hypothesis: 41% of buildings uninsured -> switching/adviser demand.

title: New consumer credit rules and SchuBerDG core provisions apply
description: CCD rules (incl. BNPL creditworthiness checks) and §§ 1-3, 5 SchuBerDG enter into force.
implication_hypothesis: Why-now for orientation on credit providers and debt counselling.

title: Consultation deadline Elementarschutz key points
description: Deadline for states and associations to comment.
implication_hypothesis: Policy timing marker.

title: Pflegefachassistenz training mainly in force
description: Most provisions of the Pflegefachassistenzgesetz apply from 1 Jan 2027.
implication_hypothesis: Training providers/care schools comparison need.

title: Planned start of key PNOG provisions; commission proposals due end Jan 2027
description: Childless surcharge increase planned; expert commission on structural reform; second stage targeted 1 July 2027.
implication_hypothesis: Media 'why now' hook for care cost/quality lists in early 2027.

title: Deutschlandticket EUR 66.80 via price index
description: Index-based price from 2027.
implication_hypothesis: Continued annual increases.

title: Altersvorsorgedepot starts; no new Riester contracts
description: Subsidy up to 540 EUR/yr; open also to self-employed.
implication_hypothesis: Provider/adviser ranking opportunity for the new depot market.

title: First Frühstart-Rente payments (cohorts 2020, 2021)
description: Payments planned from 2027.
implication_hypothesis: Timing hook for family finance content.

title: Mütterrente equalised (3 Rentenpunkte per child)
description: About 10 million beneficiaries per DRV.
implication_hypothesis: Pension-statement questions for older women.

title: E-invoice issuing obligation for firms >800,000 EUR turnover
description: Transition for paper/PDF ends for larger firms.
implication_hypothesis: Demand for digital-ready tax advisers.

title: First BEG degression step
description: Speed bonus -4 pp and cost cap -EUR 750, then every half year.
implication_hypothesis: Pull-forward demand for heating installers.

title: Digital battery passport mandatory
description: EV and industrial batteries need a digital passport (Battery Regulation 2023/1542).
implication_hypothesis: Data availability for product-level sustainability scoring.

title: Driving-licence reform main provisions apply
description: Reported start of main provisions after Bundestag adoption.
implication_hypothesis: Learners will compare driving schools on new criteria (digital, simulator, pass rates).

title: Vorhaltevergütung starts (postponed by one year)
description: Budget-neutral 2026-2027, convergence 2028-2029, full effect 2030; transition ends 2032.
implication_hypothesis: Consolidation of hospital sites 2028-2032 creates orientation needs.

title: Planned start of Primärarztsystem
description: GP as first contact, digital/phone initial assessment via 116117, appointment guarantee; draft expected end Nov 2026.
implication_hypothesis: GP choice becomes more consequential: 'TOP Hausärzte' demand.

title: E-invoice issuing obligation for all B2B
description: All B2B invoices must be e-invoices (small-business exemption).
implication_hypothesis: Peak of SME digitalisation demand.

title: Heat planning deadline for smaller municipalities
description: Original GEG deadline for municipalities <=100,000 residents.
implication_hypothesis: Second wave of heating decisions.

title: Bio-Treppe starts (10% climate-neutral fuel)
description: New gas/oil heating must use rising shares of climate-neutral fuels (10% from 2029, later 15/30/60%).
implication_hypothesis: Long-term cost risk of fossil heating needs explanation.

title: Ganztag entitlement covers grades 1-4
description: Full rollout by school year 2029/30 (date = school-year start, approximate).
implication_hypothesis: Long runway of expansion and provider growth.
